evidence.source_statement: Every time a Tampermonkey userscript is changed, including during local iteration, increment its UserScript metadata @version to a strictly higher value. This keeps script revisions distinguishable for update detection; do not wait for a formal release or distribution.
source_conditions: Every authorized script or extension modification, including local changes.
source_exceptions: Metadata changes do not independently authorize distribution.
